title: eludite.forge.pull_create input
description: Create a pull request from the current branch (Git > Create Pull Request; the Git Changes window's "Create a Pull Request" link after a push): `head` defaults to the current branch (it must be pushed), `base` to the repository's default branch, `title` to the branch's single commit's title or the branch's name, `body` to the commits' messages. `draft`, `reviewers` and `labels` where the forge offers them. For an agent, under the solution policy's `forge.write`: `prompt` (the default) makes the first write of an agent session dangerous (the Agents window asks; "Allow for this session" holds until the session ends), `allow` runs it, `deny` refuses it. The repository is the workspace's (its remote `origin`, or `remote`), detected as eludite.forge.detect does; every call runs on the forge worker off the UI thread with a timeout and stops when canceled. A call that needs a token when none is stored for the host fails with `sign_in_required: <host>`: the person signs in (Git > Sign in to <forge>); an agent cannot.
x-eludite-escalates: Execute; For an agent, under the solution policy's `forge.write`: `prompt` (the default) makes the first write of an agent session dangerous (the Agents window asks; "Allow for this session" holds until the session ends), `allow` runs it, `deny` refuses it.

items.description: A user's login (user name) on the forge; on Tangled their handle, else their DID.
A label's name (a tag on Azure DevOps).

remote.description: The git remote to read (default `origin`, else the only remote).
